name: version
notes: mod version; 1 in base game files

name: dependencies
notes: comma-separated file names this file builds on

name: references
notes: comma-separated file names referenced but not required

name: id_counter
notes: next numeric id for new string_ids ("<n>-<file>"); loader keeps the max over all files (F041671)

name: header_size
notes: v17 only, read right after filetype: byte length of version..tail

name: tail
notes: v17 only, after references up to header end: 9-10 bytes, first i32 varies (1, 9, 0x13...); meaning unknown

name: lead
notes: v16: 0. v17: 0 or the record byte length including this field

name: type
notes: record type (ItemType); names from fcs.def sections

name: string_id
notes: unique key '<n>-<file>'; references point at this

name: datatype
notes: flags: bit0 = modifies an existing record (warn if missing), bit1 = sets the name; other bits unused by the loader (F041671)

name: rotation
notes: quaternion stored w, x, y, z (zone placements start with 1.0 for identity)

name: dodge
notes: STATS record key; the skill blocking uses (defenceLevel F047048, trained by F047459)

name: vital
notes: disabling this part knocks out (from applyBodyPartDamage)

name: ko_weight
notes: weight of this part's damage in knockout time

name: flesh
notes: flesh health: cut/pierce damage (+ organ share of blunt)

name: stun
notes: blunt/stun damage, subtracted from flesh for effective health

name: downed
notes: knocked down: set by blood loss (blood KO) and by a destroyed limb

name: treated
notes: being treated (first aid): fills the treatment pool

name: focus
notes: hit-weight multiplier: +1 per hit up to 4 (1 once health frac < 0), 0 when destroyed; decays toward 1 by dt*0.01 while flesh >= 0

name: treatment
notes: treatment pool: heals into flesh over time

name: kind
notes: LOCATIONAL_DAMAGE "body part type": 0 torso, 1 leg, 2 arm, 3 head; limb slot = leg: 2/3, arm: 0/1 by side; low strikes skip arms and head

name: side
notes: which of a limb pair (1 = first slot)

name: hit_weight
notes: relative chance this part is hit (resolveHit)

name: dead
notes: set by update when blood < -maxBlood, health < 0 or a vital part is lost

name: wounds
notes: bleeding wounds; each has remaining amount at +0x14, clots by bleeding clot rate

name: hunger
notes: nutrition level, capped at 3.0; starvation death below 0

name: hunger_time
notes: game time of the last hunger update

name: load
notes: encumbrance factor (1 = unburdened): hunger, martial arts, defence and XP gains scale by it

name: cut_into_stun
notes: share of stopped cut (and pierce) that becomes stun, [0, 1]

name: material
notes: ARMOUR "material type" (ArmourType: cloth, leather, chain, plate); also the hit material

name: coverage
notes: body part -> chance this piece covers it on a hit ("part coverage")

name: quality
notes: 0..1 item quality; lerp factor for the material ranges

name: cut_base
notes: damage at the bottom of the cut curve

name: weapon_skill
notes: the skill field the category selects

name: category
notes: record int "skill category" (WeaponCategory), read at item setup (F044624)

name: damage_mult
notes: scales all attack damage when != 1 and > 0

name: low_strike
notes: can only hit torso and legs (resolveHit)

name: frames
notes: {direction i32, power f32, impact f32 ('anim blocked frame': the strike connects), stop f32 (the move ends), limb i32}, 0x14 each

name: combat_speed
notes: combat animation speed factor (technique speed * it)

name: max_reach
notes: longest technique reach found by gatherAttacks (10 by default)

name: progress
notes: time / length; what combat reads (actionProgress F038894)

name: synced
notes: follows a shared phase instead of its own clock

name: events
notes: sorted by progress; count +0x78, cursor +0x8c, last progress +0x88

name: start_near_end
notes: first update jumps to 96% of the clip

name: fade_rate
notes: animation blend rate (GLOBAL CONSTANTS, 4) * the layer's multiplier (F040013)

name: root_motion
notes: this clip moves the character (its root translation is extracted)
